reason: I only hate the water a few times a year when I'm in a hotel, and I've got a Brita at home, so $68 up front plus a filter subscription is way too much for a problem I barely have. The cheaper route without a plan is still $63 with shipping, which is a lot on my income.
objection: The deal only looks decent if I sign up for a filter plan, and I've been burned by subscriptions that were a pain to cancel. Filters every 2 months make no sense for someone who travels a few times a year.
would_change_my_mind: A bottle under about $30 with free shipping and one-off filter packs I can buy when I need them, no subscription.
